actorKind.description: The actor kind the token must claim.

institution.description:
The institution this profile acts for. The Document Store records it
as the issuing institution of every document version a caller under
this profile reserves; a profile that names none records none.

principalClaim.description:
`sub`, or the name of another string claim identifying the principal.
Every profile of one actor kind names the same claim.

requesterClients.description: The OAuth clients whose tokens resolve to this profile; at least one.

requiredScopes.description: The scopes a token must carry; at least one.

role.description: What a caller resolved to this profile is to a document.

AccessRole.description: What a caller resolved to an access profile is to a document.

oneOf.description: Places documents in custody and issues document grants.
The person on whose behalf custody is held.
Reads exactly the document version a document grant names.

ActorKind.description: An actor kind: a service, or a human person.

ContentType.description: A lowercase concrete media type `type/subtype` without parameters or wildcards, matched exactly.

CustodianRule.description: Who holds a document a service places for a named person.

oneOf.description:
Custody stays with the reserving system, acting for its
institution. The named person is recorded as the represented
principal and has no standing on the document; only a document
grant releases it to them.

The named person is the custodian. The reserving system sees the
document's metadata and status but is neither released its content
nor allowed to grant on it.

DisplayText.description: Human-readable display text. Bidirectional embedding, override, and isolate controls, byte-order marks, line and paragraph separators, and Unicode noncharacters are refused; multilingual joiners and direction marks remain valid.

DocumentPolicy.description:
One document policy: who may hold, grant, and receive a document held
under it, and the restrictions every such document carries.

custodian.description:
Who holds a document a service places for a named person: the
reserving system for its institution, or that person.

custodyProfiles.description: Profiles that may place a document in custody under this policy.

grantingProfiles.description:
Profiles that may issue a document grant on a document they hold in
custody under this policy. A system that only reserved a document for
another custodian never grants on it.

recipientProfiles.description: Profiles a document grant may name as its recipient.

representedPrincipalGrants.description: Whether the represented principal may issue document grants itself.

representedPrincipalProfile.description: The profile a represented principal authenticates under.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

HookHandler.description:
Where an observer hook delivers, chosen by its `type` member: a URL
destination the runtime configuration binds under `destinations.hooks`.

HookPhase.description: When an observer hook runs relative to the triggering transaction.

policies.description:
The document policies whose documents the observer hears about: a
change to a document held under any other policy captures nothing
for it. Listing them is the operator's declaration of who may
receive which documents' events.

projection.description: The fields of the trigger's projection the observer receives.

HookTrigger.description: The committed change an observer hook follows.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

MandatoryRestrictions.description: The restrictions every document held under a policy carries.

allowedContentTypes.description: The media types a document may be declared as, matched exactly.

cleanupGraceHours.description:
Time between the custodian's removal request, or a rejection, and
erasure of the bytes, and the length of a reservation's upload
window. At least one hour, so an operator always has a window to
restore from a mistaken request. Grant expiry and revocation erase
nothing: they only stop a grant releasing.

maximumCustodianBytes.description:
The bytes one custodian may hold under this policy, counted over
every reserved or stored version not yet erased and checked at
reservation.

maximumDocumentBytes.description:
The largest document a reservation may declare. It may not exceed
the deployment ceiling `storage.maximumDocumentBytes`; the runtime
refuses to start otherwise.

ProjectIdentity.description:
The members that name a project (CFG-ENV-6): a project's `project` block
holds these, and may add project-wide members of the product's own.
Schema name `ProjectIdentity`.

RepresentedPrincipalGrants.description: Whether a represented principal may issue document grants itself.

accessProfiles.description: The caller profiles a document policy names, by id.

documentPolicies.description: The policies a document is held under, by id.

hooks.description: After-commit observer hooks. A project with none omits the member.
